home.researchTitle: Ājmour an kōmālolo: ta eo etale ko rej ba
home.researchText: Emaron̄ ke bōprae nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k? Ikkure in kōmālolo ko rej ke jiban̄? Ak kōn jitlo̧k, m̧ōn̄ā, kiki im ron̄jake? Uwaak ko rebidodo im tōprak jān kam̧ool ko, koba jikin ko me kam̧ool ko rejaab kanooj pedpād ie.
home.researchLink: Riit kōmeļeļe ko jān etale ko
home.appTitle: Golden Moments ilo iPhone, iPad im Android
home.appText: App in ejjeļo̧k wōņāān ej jerbal n̄e ejjeļo̧k intōnet im emaron̄ kōjerbal pija ko an baamle eo kwōj kāāleti, rej kōjparok ilo m̧ōttan eo am wōt. Ejja wāween eo wōt: tile ko emān rekilep, ejjeļo̧k awa, ejjeļo̧k buin kōttōbar.

faq.q: Ta ikkure ko rem̧m̧an n̄an ro ewōr meļo̧kļo̧k ippāer?
faq.a: Ikki ko rem̧m̧an rej pidodo, jejeļā kajjieer im ejjeļo̧k inepata ie: pija ko rekilep n̄an kōkobaiki, kōlaajraki men ko, pija in jigsaw repidodo, kadedelo̧k jabōn-kōnnaan ko rebuñbuñ, kōkaļe kōn kōla, bingo in pija im kaat ko n̄an bwebwenato. Kōāālet eo em̧m̧antata ej eo armij eo ej m̧ōņōnō kake rainin. Jab kōjerbal kuro̧o̧k in idiik, bun̄tōn ko, ak jabdewōt men me ej āinwōt juon mālejjon̄.

faq.q: Ikki kein n̄an armij ro ewōr nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k ippāer ejjeļo̧k ke wōņāer?
faq.a: Aet. Aolep ikki im peba ko kwomaron̄ printe ilo Golden Moments ejjeļo̧k wōņāer, ejjeļo̧k aikuj n̄an kōm̧m̧an akaun, dāpdep etam̧, ak download e men otemjej. Ikki kein rej jerbal ilo web browser ilo talboon, tablet, ak kom̧pūta.

faq.q: Ikki ko n̄an kōmālij remaron̄ ke bōbrae nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k?
faq.a: Ejjeļo̧k juon ikki em̧ōj an kwaļo̧k bwe ej bōbrae nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k, im Golden Moments ejjab ba bwe ej kemour ak bōbrae jabdewōt nañinmej. Ikki ko am rej n̄an m̧ōņōnō im pād ippān doon. Ra eo am kōn ājmour in kōmālij ej kōmeļeļeik kōn ta ko ekkatak ko rej kwaļo̧k im ta ko rejjab kwaļo̧k.

faq.q: Ikki kein rekar ke n̄an juon eo ewōr nañinmej in Alzheimer's ippān?
faq.a: Aet. Nañinmej in Alzheimer's ej un eo ekaankata n̄an nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k, im em̧ōj kōm̧m̧an ikki kein n̄an e: pija ko rekilep me rej pād wōt im alikar, jidik wōt kōāālet ko, im ejjeļo̧k menin kakeememej ak bōd ie. Kōkobaiki pija ko, kōlaajraki men ko, im kadedelo̧k jabōn-kōnnaan ko jejeļā kake rej kōjerbal jeļāļo̧kjeņ ko me ruto ilo kōmālij ijello̧kun katak men ko rekāāl.

faq.q: Juon ke eo ej pād ilo jekjek ko tokālik ilo nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k emaron̄ kōjerbal makūtkūt kein?
faq.a: Ekkā an aet, n̄e ewōr juon armij ippān. Jino kōn Pukot eo āinwōt kōn ruo pija, Pair in pija ko kōn emān tile, juon peba in kōkaļe kōla, ak juon kakkije in menono eaenōm̧m̧an. Kōm̧m̧an bwe en kadu wōt, ļoor aer m̧ōņōnō kake, im kakkije n̄e rebuñbūruwōr ak reaikuj kakkije.

faq.q: Meļeļe ko aō rej ke dāpdep wōt im nooj?
faq.a: Jikin in ejjeļo̧k akaun ie im ejjeļo̧k kōmeļeļe in kakkōt. Kōmij kōjerbal Google Analytics n̄an jeļā peij ta ko armij rej lali. Pija ko kwōj kōāāleti n̄an Photo pairs rej waal wōt ilo browser eo am̧ im rejjab uploadļo̧k.

Golden Moments ej juon kurup edik me ej kōm̧m̧an makūtkūt in pija ko reaenōm̧m̧an n̄an rūtto ro, baam̧le ko, im ri-lale ro, ilo web im āinwōt juon app me ejjeļo̧k wōņāān. Kōmij jab taktō, im ejjeļo̧k menin me ej kapilōk in takto.

brain-health.lede: Ta ko ekkatak ko rekilep rej kwaļo̧k kōn kōkāātļo̧k kauwōtata in bōk nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k, kōmeļeļeiki ilo pidodo, ekoba ijo kein kam̧ool ko rejjab kajoor ie ak erōkoba. Meļeļe ko n̄an aolep, ejjab kapilōk in takto.

guide.byTeam: Jān tiim eo ilo Golden Moments
guide.sourcesNote: Kōmij kōkobaiki n̄an doulul ko im ekkatak ko me peij in ej pedped ioor. Em̧ōj etale kajjojo iien eo me peij in ear kōkkāāl.

healthNotice.title: Meļeļe ko n̄an aolep, ejjab kapilōk in takto
healthNotice.textHtml: Peij in ej kōkadduikļo̧k ekkatak ko em̧ōj kwaļo̧ki n̄an baam̧le ko. Ejjab maron̄ jiron̄ eok ta eo ej jim̧we n̄an juon wōt armij. Kōnono ippān taktō m̧okta jān am̧ kōkāāle m̧ōn̄ā, kakkōlkōl ānbwin, kiki, uno ko, ak men ko n̄an kakkobaiki ājmour. N̄e ewōr bōkļo̧k kōmālij kōn idik ak oktak ko reidid, pukot jipañ jān takto kiiō wōt. Riiti kōjjeļā eo am̧ kōn meļeļe in ājmour.

about.title: Juon Makūtkūt in Ippān Doon, Ejjab juon Mālejjon̄ in Kakeemejmej
about.seoTitle: Kōn Golden Moments: Wāween Kōm̧m̧an eo Am̧
about.description: Etke ikki ko an Golden Moments ejjeļo̧k kuro̧o̧k in idiik, bun̄tōn ko, ak laajrak in kōttan ko ie, etke pija ko rej pād wōt im alikar, im ta ko kōmij ba im jab ba kōn nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k.
about.lede: Golden Moments ej kōm̧m̧an makūtkūt in pija ko reaenōm̧m̧an n̄an rūtto ro me juon ri-lale im juon eo ewōr nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k ippān remaron̄ lan̄lōn̄ kake ippān doon.
about.bodyHtml:
Men ko jōj tōmak kaki

Unin kajjojo makūtkūt ej kōm̧m̧an bwe en em̧m̧an iien eo ippān doon: kōnono ippān doon, ettōñ, m̧ōņōņō ilo an kobaiki ruo pija ko, ak ilo an baj jijet wōt iturin doon. Ej jab n̄an jon̄e juon armij, kakūm̧ūr er bwe ren kōm̧m̧ani men ko reppen, ak n̄an kam̧ool jabdewōt men.

Elōn̄ app ko n̄an kōkāāl kōm̧ļo̧k rej kōm̧m̧an kōn m̧ōkaj, buin jān bōk poin, kakoba wōt win ko, im dōrwōj ko reppenļo̧k. N̄an juon armij eo ewōr nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k ippān, men in emaron̄ einwōt juon teej eo ejan̄in maron̄ bōke. Kem ar kōm̧m̧ani men kein ilo wāween eo ejab einwōt er, im kemij lale kake kajjojo kien kein:

  • Ejeļo̧k luuj. Ejeļo̧k kūļo̧k, buin poin, buin makūtkūt, mour ko, win ko ijjilōkdoon, confetti ak bwine awa n̄an jem̧ļo̧k, ilo jabdewōt koon.
  • Kile jān an aikuj kememej. Pija ko rej pād wōt alikkar iien otemjej. Kajjitōk ko rej kappeik n̄an kōnono doon im ejjab n̄an kajjitōk kōn āt ko ak kememej ko m̧okta.
  • Kileplep, ajeļo̧k im pād wōt juon jikier. Jeje im pija ko rekilep, ajeļo̧k kōļar ko, im jikin jibwe ko rej pād wōt ilo juon wōt jikin.
  • Kautiej armij rūtto. Pija ko rekam̧ool jān laļ in im naan ko reajeļo̧k im tōpālie. Ejeļo̧k pija in cartoon, al in nōbar einwōt n̄an ajri, ak wōtōm̧ōļ in emoji.
  • Pidodo an jem̧ļo̧k. Naan in “Bōjrak kiiō” ej pād wōt ilo iien otemjej. Bōjrak ilo io̧lapān wōt ej juon jem̧ļo̧k eo em̧m̧an.
  • Ettino iien otemjej. Ejeļo̧k account ak kōllaajrak in wia. Pija ko kwoj kāāleti rej pād wōt ilo kein kōjerbal eo am̧.

Ta ko kem jab ba kake

Ikkiilbwij ko am rej n̄an m̧ōņōņō im kōm̧m̧an bwe kom̧in pād ippān doon. Rejjab loe jorrāān, teej, jon̄e, kōmour, kōm̧m̧an bwe en rum̧wijļo̧k, ak bōbrae nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k ak Alzheimer’s, im ejeļo̧k armij en kāālōt er kōn unin in. Ilo am jeje kōn etale ko ilo am peij ko kōn ājmour in kōm̧ļo̧k, kemij kōmeļeļeik ajeļo̧k n̄e kam̧ool ko rejjab kajoor, im kem jab kōbaiki n̄an ikkiilbwij ko am make.

Wōn kem

Golden Moments ej juon kumi kijdik eo ej make doon. Kem jab dōkto ro. Kappe ko am rej jeje jān meļeļe ko em̧ōj kwalo̧ki jān doulul ko einwōt National Institute on Aging im Alzheimer’s Association, im kajjojo kappe ej kwalo̧k jikin ko kem ar bōki jān er. Riit wāween am jeje im etale peij ko am.

Kwalo̧k n̄an kem ta eo emaron̄ jipañ

Kem kōņaan ron̄ ta ko rej jerbal ippām̧ im ta ko rejjab, aolepen jān armij ro ewōr nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k ippāer, baamle ro rej lale er, im ro rej kōm̧m̧an makūtkūt ko. Jilkinļo̧k email n̄an {email}.

editorial.title: Wāween Am Jeje im Etale Peij Ko Am
editorial.description: Wāween an Golden Moments bukot meļeļe, jeje, bōk jān jikin ko rettiljek, im kakāāl peij ko kōn makūtkūt n̄an nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k im ājmour in kōm̧ļo̧k, im ta ko ban kōm̧m̧ani n̄an peij kein.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Jikin ko kem bōk meļeļe jānier

Kemij pedped ilo kappe ko am jān meļeļe ko an aolep armij jān doulul ko einwōt National Institute on Aging, CDC, Alzheimer’s Association, Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, Family Caregiver Alliance im NHS, im etale ko rūtto me ritōļ ro jet rar etale einwōt Cochrane reviews im kōm̧m̧an etale kajjieon̄ ko rekilep. Kajjojo kappe ej kwalo̧k aolep jikin ko ear bōk meļeļe jān er. Kemij kōppelļo̧k kajjojo jikin m̧okta jān am bōk naan ko jān e, im kemij baj kwalo̧k wōt ta eo ej kam̧ool ba.

Wāween am jeje

  • Men ko rej jerbal kiiō: ta eo kwo maron̄ kōm̧m̧ane rainin, ilo kajin eo ejeļo̧k.
  • M̧ool kōn kam̧ool ko: kemij ba “ekkein koba ippān”, “emaron̄” im “kam̧ool ko reoktak jān doon” n̄e ej men in em̧ool.
  • Kautiej: kemij jeje kōn armij ro ewōr nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k ippāer einwōt armij rūtto, im kem jab kōjerbal naan ko rej kappeik teej ak kōm̧m̧an jokpeļo̧k.
  • Ejeļo̧k bwebwenato ko rej baj kōm̧m̧ani: ejeļo̧k nōmba in etale ko ririab, naan in bōk ko, ro rej jeļā kake, katak ko, etale ko ak naan in kam̧ool ko rejjab m̧ool.

Wōn ro rej etale peij ko am

Peij ko rej jeje im etale jān kumi eo an Golden Moments, ippān jipañ jān kein jeje in AI n̄an kappok meļeļe im jeje eo jinointa. Kajjojo peij kumi in ej bar etale ippān jikin ko kem ar bōk meļeļe jān er. Peij ko am rejan̄in etale jān dōkto ak ri-uno ro, im kem jab ba bwe em̧ōj an dōkto etale. Er rej meļeļe ko baj kappeik wōt, ejjab kappe in uno ak dōkto.

Ta ko kem ban kōm̧m̧ani ilo peij kein

  • Naan ko rej ba juon ikkiilbwij, m̧ōn̄ā, supplement, jitōb/haiting ak makūtkūt ej bōbrae, kōmour, kakōm̧anm̧anļo̧k ak kōm̧m̧an bwe en rum̧wijļo̧k nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k.
  • Teej, kajjitōk ko ak buin poin ko rej kappeik bwe juon armij ewōr, ak ejeļo̧k, nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k ippān.
  • Rōjan̄ n̄an jinoe, bōjrak jān e, ak kōkāāle jabdewōt uno.
  • Wiaik jikin ko ak meļeļe ko em̧ōj kōļļā kake me rej kile bwe rej kappe.

Kōkāāl im jim̧we ko

Kajjojo peij ej kwalo̧k raan eo ear jem̧ļo̧k an kōkāāl. N̄e kwoj lo juon bōd ak jikin eo meļeļe eo an em̧ōj an mor, joij im email {email} im kem naaj etale ilo m̧ōkaj.

faq.title: Kajjitōk im Uwaak Ko
faq.seoTitle: Ikkiilbwij im Makūtkūt Ko n̄an Nañinmej in Meļo̧kļo̧k: Kajjitōk im Uwaak Ko
faq.description: Uwaak ko n̄an kajjitōk ko rekoba kōn ikkiilbwij im makūtkūt ko n̄an ro ewōr nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k ippāer: ikkiilbwij ta ko n̄an kajjieon̄i, ewi aitokan an aikuj ikkure, ļōmņak ko n̄an iien ko toļo̧k, ājmour in kōm̧ļo̧k, im ettino.
faq.lede: Uwaak ko rekaddu im ajeļo̧k n̄an kajjitōk ko armij ro rej lale rej kajjitōk aolep iien.

items.q: Ikkiilbwij ta ko rem̧m̧antata n̄an juon eo ewōr nañinmej in meļo̧kļo̧k ippān?
items.a: Ikkiilbwij ko rem̧m̧antata rej men ko rejeļā kajiier, pidodo, im ejeļo̧k kajjioñ ak inebata ie, im eo ejim̧wetata ej jabdewōt eo armij eo ej m̧ōņōņō kake rainin. Kobaiki pija ko me rej alikkar wōt, kalōke kajjojo kōļar ak pija, pija ko pidodo n̄an kobaik doon, kadedeikļo̧k naan in kōkaļļe ko me ejeļā kajiier, kōļari pija, im bingo in pija rej jerbal n̄an elōn̄ armij. Jab kōjerbal awa in buin, poin ko, im jabdewōt men me ej einwōt teej.

items.q: Ikkiilbwij kein rej m̧ool ke bwe rejjab kōļļā kaki?
items.a: Aet. Aolep ikkure ko im peba ko remaron̄ kōm̧m̧ani bōk ejjeļo̧k wōnāer, im ejjeļo̧k account, kajjitōk in kadiwōj etam̧, dounlood, ak kōjeļā in wia kake.

items.q: Etke ejjeļo̧k būlaak in point, level ko, ak kuro̧k in iien?
items.a: M̧ōkaj im point remaron̄ kōm̧m̧an bwe juon kakkije en erom juon teej, eo emaron̄ kōm̧m̧an jook ak inepata. Kōmij dāpij kōttobar eo ilo m̧ōņōn̄ō im koba ippān doon, kōn men in ejjeļo̧k men en kwoj luuji im kwomaron̄ kakkije ilo jabdewōt iien.

items.q: Ta kein kōm̧m̧an ko rem̧m̧an tata kōjerbali?
items.a: Jabdewōt talboon, tablet, ak kom̧pituuta eo ewōr broujer ekāāl kake. Juon tablet ilo juon stand ioon tebōl ej wāween eo em̧m̧an tata n̄an ruo armej n̄an koba ikkure ippān doon. Juon laptop ej koba ippān TV em̧m̧an n̄an kumi in armej ro.

items.q: Kōm maron̄ ke kōjerbal pija in baam̧le ko am make?
items.a: Aet. Ikkure in pija kein rōkoba (Photo pairs) ej kōjerbal 2 n̄an 6 pija ko kwōj kāāleti n̄an juon ikkure in kakobaba. Pija ko rej pād wōt ilo broujer eo am̧ im ejjeļo̧k en ej uploode ak kakkōpiji.

items.q: Ewi tōre eo ej aikuj aetok kake juon m̧akūtkūt?
items.a: Kajjojo iien 10 n̄an 20 m̧initi em̧ōj an bōk iien, im jet iien 2 m̧initi em̧m̧an wōt. Kalimjōk kōkāālele in m̧ōk ak inepata im kōjparok bwe en kakkije ke ej m̧ōņōn̄ō wōt. Ejjeļo̧k oran iien eo em̧m̧an tata.

items.q: Ta n̄e rejjab kōnāān kōm̧m̧ane juon m̧akūtkūt?
items.a: Kautiej aer jab kōnāān, im kajjioon bar juon alen tokelik ak ilo bar juon wāween. An juon armej jab kōnāān emaron̄ itok jān m̧ōk, metak, jab lōke e make, ak baj ejjab itoklimo wōt kake. Lale bokin kōmeļeļe eo am kōn ta ko kwomaron̄ kōm̧m̧ani n̄e rej ba jaab.

items.q: Ta m̧akūtkūt ko rem̧m̧an n̄an ro ewōr nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k ippāer ilo iien ko rōtoklik?
items.a: Aenōm̧m̧an im en̄jake ko: ron̄jake al ko rejitōnbōro, pāj peier kōn lotion, alwōj pija ko ippān doon, dāpij juon kōōj emāni, jijet itulik, ak juon ikkure in pija ebidodo ippān juon armej ituriier. Bokin kōmeļeļe eo am kōn iien ko rōtoklik ewōr elōn̄ļo̧k lōmņak ie.

items.q: Ewōr ke m̧akūtkūt ko n̄an kumi ilo jikin jiban̄ im kejparok?
items.a: Aet. Pija in bingo ewōr kaat ko kwomaron̄ printe im juon kanooj ilo jikriin, im ikkure in kadedeļo̧k jabōnkōnnaan ko im kaat in bwebwenato rem̧m̧an n̄an kōnono aolepān kōn ainikien eļap. Bokin kōmeļeļe eo am kōn kumi ilo m̧ōn kejparok ej koba kake uwaan kumi, jikin jijet, im kōkkāāl m̧akūtkūt ko n̄an aolep kain mālim.

items.q: Ikkure ko remaron̄ ke bōprae ak kōrum̧wij nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k?
items.a: Ejjeļo̧k juon ikkure em̧ōj an kaalikkar bwe ej bōprae nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k (dementia), im ikkure ko am rejjab ba ke remaron̄ kōm̧m̧ane men in. Katak ko rej kwalo̧k bwe rōjan̄ kōmālim ilo koba ippān doon emaron̄ lelok jidik jiban̄ n̄an ro ewōr jidik m̧ōttan nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k ippāer, ak eoktak jān an juon ikkure bōprae nan̄inmej. Kōmij letok ikkure kein n̄an leen m̧ōņōn̄ō im koba ippān doon.

items.q: Emaron̄ ke bōprae nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k?
items.a: Ejjab alikkar kōn lukkuun jān jem̧ļo̧k eo. Etale ko rej kwalo̧k koba kōtaan 14 jekjek in mour im ājmour ippān men ko remaron̄ kōm̧m̧an bwe en waļo̧k nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k, āinwōt jab ron̄jake, bōto̧ktōk eļap, jab m̧akūtkūt, im an juon armej make iaan. Kōkāāl men kein emaron̄ kōkāāle an jab bōk nan̄inmej eo n̄an jet armej, ak elōn̄ armej ro rej kōm̧m̧an men ko rem̧m̧an rej pād wōt ilo nan̄inmej in. Ejjab bōd eo an jabdewōt.

items.q: Kōjekdoo̧n m̧ōn̄ā ilo jet iien em̧m̧an ke n̄an ājmour in kōmālim?
items.a: Meļeļe ko jān etale armej rejidik wōt im kōm̧m̧an ilo jinoin, im elōn̄ iaan etale ko rej kōm̧m̧an ilo menninmour ko. Kōjekdoo̧n m̧ōn̄ā emaron̄ kōm̧m̧an kauwōtata n̄an rūtto ro, eļaptata n̄e ewōr uno in tōn̄al ak m̧ōjin an armej rūn̄ļo̧k jān kōm̧m̧an, im rejjab kōkm̧anm̧an bwe en kōm̧m̧an kōn ro ewōr nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k ippāer. Bwebwenato ippān juon taktō m̧okta jān am̧ ukōt wāween am̧ m̧ōn̄ā.

Ejjeļo̧k account ak kōjeļā in wia. Kōmij kōjerbal Google Analytics n̄an bwine jepeļpeļ ko im lale peij ta ko rej jiban̄, im broujer eo am ej keememej n̄e kwoar kōjerbal ainikien emāni. Pija ko kwōj kāāleti n̄an Photo pairs ejjeļo̧k uploode er. Lale kōjeļā in dāpij naan n̄an meļeļe ko reļapļo̧k.

items.q: Meļeļe kein rej ke kakeel in takto?
items.a: Jaab. Golden Moments ej n̄an kakkije im meļeļe ko aolep. Kōn kajjitōk ko kōn ājmour, bwebwenato ippān taktō, im n̄an iien kauwōtata ko kōrōl 911.

faq.moreHtml: Meļeļe ko reļapļo̧k: ejei amiro koba ikkure, n̄e rej ba jaab, m̧akūtkūt ko n̄an iien ko rōtoklik im emaron̄ ke bōprae nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k?

handout.title: Ikkure ko Reidik im Ejjeļo̧k Wōnāer n̄an Ro Ewōr Nan̄inmej in Meļo̧kļo̧k Ippāer
handout.seoTitle: Peba in Printe: Ikkure ko Ejjeļo̧k Wōnāer n̄an Nan̄inmej in Meļo̧kļo̧k ilo Online
handout.description: Juon peba emaron̄ printe n̄an baam̧le im ro rej lale kōn ikkure in pija ko reidik im ejjeļo̧k wōnāer n̄an ro ewōr nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k ippāer, n̄an kumi in jiban̄ im bōkake in jiban̄.
handout.lede: Printe peba in n̄an kumi in jiban̄, peba in kejparok, ak dāpij ioon kōjām in aijbokij. Kōjerbal kien Printe ilo broujer eo am̧; būtin ko im bwidej ko rejjab maron̄ pād ilo peba eo.
handout.introHtml: Pija reļļap, naan rebidodo im ejjeļo̧k men kwomaron̄ luuji ie. Ejjeļo̧k wōnāer ilo talboon, tablet ak kom̧pituuta, ejjeļo̧k kōm̧m̧an account, ejjeļo̧k kōjeļā in wia, ejjeļo̧k kuro̧k in iien im ejjeļo̧k būlaak in point. Jijet ippān doon im bōk iien.
handout.gamesTitle: Ikkure ko kwomaron̄ kajjiooni koba ippān doon
handout.restHtml:
Jet kōmeļeļe ko

  • Kāālet juon iien ilo raan eo ke armej eo ej pād ilo an kanooj m̧m̧an būruon.
  • Jino kōn jekjek eo ebidodo tata. Emān pāāk ko ebwe.
  • Bwebwenato kōn pija ko. Bwebwenato eo kajjojo iien ej m̧ōttan eo em̧m̧an tata.
  • Kakkije ke ej m̧ōņōn̄ō wōt. Kōm̧m̧an jem̧ļo̧k m̧okta ej juon men em̧m̧an.

Pād bar ilo website in

  • Peba ko printe ejjeļo̧k wōnāer: kapukot naan kōn jeje reļļap, peba in kalōk, kaat in bwebwenato im pija in bingo.
  • Lōmņak ko kōn m̧akūtkūt n̄an aolep iien, im bokin kōmeļeļe kōn koba ikkure im lale kwe make.

N̄an m̧ōņōn̄ō im iien koba ippān doon. Ejjab kakeel in taktō, teej, ak wāween taktō. Golden Moments ej kejeļāik jān Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.description: Wāween an m̧ōn lale rūtto ro, jikin pād ilo raan ñan rūtto ro, m̧ōn jeje ko, opij ko an rūtto ro, im kumi in jipan̄ ko kōjerbal ikkure ko am ejjeļo̧k oņāer kōn nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k, barāinwōt naan ko ñan kobaiktok kōm ilo laajrak in jipan̄ ko am.
organizations.lede: Aolep men ko ilo jikin in ejjeļo̧k oņāer ñan kōjerbali ippān ro rej jokwe ilo m̧ōko, membōr ro, im armej ro kwoj jipan̄ er, ejjeļo̧k account, laijen, ak wōņāān. Peij in ej kōmeļeļeik ta ko rej pād ijoko im wāween am maron̄ ajeji.
organizations.shortText: {name}: ikkure in pija ko reainem̧m̧an im ejjeļo̧k oņāer im laajrak in tōl kōn makūtkūt ko ñan armej ro rej mour kōn nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k im ro rej lale er. Ejjeļo̧k sign-up, ejjeļo̧k awa in ikkure, ejjeļo̧k bōnbōn in point.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) ej kōm̧m̧an bwe en pād {count} ikkure ko ilo browser me ejjeļo̧k oņāer im kar kōm̧m̧ani ñan armej ro rej mour kōn nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k, koba kakonono pija ko kōn aer pād wōt pija ko me maron̄ loi, jigsaw me ebidodo, kainbōk men ko, naan in kōkāāl ko me jele kaki, im picture bingo ippān kaat ko me maron̄ printi. Ejjeļo̧k account, kakōļļe in kakkwōjkwōj, awa in kōm̧akoko, ak point. Barāinwōt jikin in ej letok laajrak in tōl kōn makūtkūt ko ilo kajin ebwe an meļeļe kōn kajjojo iien ko ilo nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k me rej kōjerbal bōk naan jān National Institute on Aging im Alzheimer's Association.
organizations.useTitle: Men ko doulul ko remaron̄ kōjerbali
organizations.gamesItemHtml: {count} ikkure ilo browser me rej jerbal ilo laptop, tablet, ak TV eo em̧ōj kobaiki ñan computer. Ejjeļo̧k install, account, ak download. Lale aolep ikkure.
organizations.printablesAfter: Kōjerbal butten eo me ej ba Print ilo kajjojo peij.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Wāween ikkure ilo kumi: Picture bingo ewōr kaat ko maron̄ printi im juon eo ej kūr kōn pija ilo screen, im easy trivia ewōr 50 kajjitōk ko ippān kāālet in uwaak ko im men ko ñan kōnono kaki.
  • Laajrak in tōl kōn makūtkūt ko ñan ri-jerbal ro im baam̧le ko, ekkar ñan kajjojo jekjek im kajjojo kain, kar je ilo kajin ebidodo an meļeļe ippān jikin ko kwaļo̧k naan jān er. Jinoe kōn 101 lomņak kōn makūtkūt ak makūtkūt ko an kumi ñan m̧ōn lale rūtto ro.
organizations.restHtml:
Wāween an kumi ko kōjerbali

  • M̧ōn lale rūtto im jikin lale nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k: picture bingo ak kadedeikļo̧k naan in kōkāāl ko ilo TV eo ilo ruum̧ eo an aolep, ippān juon armej ej jidikdik kōn pein ñan kumi eo.
  • Purokram̧ ko an rūtto ilo raan: juon jikin tablet kōn Picture pairs em̧ōj kōm̧m̧ane ñan emān pija, ñan iien ko rekaddok ñan armej ruo.
  • M̧ōn jeje ko an aolep: pukot naan ko em̧ōj printi im kaat in bwebwenato ilo bakej in keememej ko, im kakōļļeik jikin in ilo tablet ko an m̧ōn jeje.
  • Kumi in jipan̄ an ro rej lale armej im memory café ko: juon peba in meļeļe me maron̄ printe ñan an baam̧le ko bōke ñan m̧weo.
  • Aujpitōl ko im ro rej kōpooj armej ñan jeorļo̧k jān jikin taktō: peba in meļeļe ilo bōkōj ko an ro rej lale armej, bwe en wōr juon men eainem̧m̧an ñan kōm̧m̧ane ilo m̧weo ak iturin peet eo.

Men ko jej jab kōm̧m̧ani

Ikkure kein rej ñan lañlōn̄ im pād ippān doon. Rej jab ekkatak kōn nan̄inmej, jab māletlet, jab bōnbōn point, jab kōmour ak jab bōbrae an nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k kōkkūkļo̧k, im kōmij kajjitōk ippān doulul ko bwe ren jab kōmeļeļeiki ilo wāween in. Ejjeļo̧k kakōļļe in kakkwōjkwōj, im ikkure kein rej jab kajjitōk kōn āt, meļeļe kōn ājmour, ak pija ko ñan upload er. Web jikin in ej kōjerbal Google Analytics ñan bōnbōn armej ro rej lotok; am kōmeļeļe kōn jānōk ej kwaļo̧k ta ko ej aini. Pija ko rej kōjerbali ilo Photo pairs rej pād wōt ilo browser eo.

Kobaiktok kōm ilo laajrak in jipan̄ ko am

Eļan̄n̄e ewōr am laajrak in jipan̄ ko ñan ro rej lale armej, kwoj maron̄ link ñan {domain}. Kwoj maron̄ kōpii jabdewōt iaan kōmeļeļe kein.
organizations.linksHtml:
Peij ko reaurōk ñan link ñani jim̧or: ikkure ko ejjeļo̧k oņāer, men ko maron̄ printi me ejjeļo̧k oņāer, makūtkūt ko kōn Alzheimer's im wāween ikkure ippān doon.

Kajjitōk ko ak men ko ñan kōkāāl

Eļan̄n̄e ewōr men ebaad ak ejab alikkar ilo jikin in, ak men ko rej pād ijoko rej jab tōpar aikuj ko an ro rej jokwe ilo m̧ōko, jouj im ba maii ilo {email}. Jouj im jab jilkintok meļeļe ko an armej kajjojo ak meļeļe kōn ājmour an ro rej jokwe ak kiliin ro.

app.title: App eo an Golden Moments
app.seoTitle: App eo an Golden Moments ñan iPhone im Android
app.description: App eo an Golden Moments me ejjeļo̧k oņāān: kakonono pija eainem̧m̧an kōn emān pija rekileplep, pija ko an baam̧le rej pād wōt ilo device eo am̧, bōkōj in pija ko me kwoj maron̄ kōjerbali n̄e ejjeļo̧k intōnēt, im ejjeļo̧k account.
app.lede: Aolep men ko kwoj kōņaan kaki ilo website eo, ilo juon app me ej jerbal n̄e ejjeļo̧k intōnēt im emaron̄ kōjerbal pija ko an baam̧le me kwoj kāāleti.
app.bodyHtml:
Jinoe jidik

Jino kōn emān teiļ rekilep im pija ko me kwoj jeļā kajjier. Kōm̧m̧an bwe pija ko ren alikkar wōt, ak noji n̄e em̧m̧anļo̧k. Ilo wāween eo epidodo ejjeļo̧k awa, jeik ak kaje. Kāālōt 4, 6, 8 ak 12 teiļ.

Kōm̧m̧an bwe en an am̧ baamle

Kāālōt pija ko an baamle kōn jikin kāālōt pija ilo tūrinpeba eo am̧. App in enaaj kōjparok kōpe ko redik n̄an m̧akūtkūt ko an. Eban etale aolep pija ko am̧ ak ukōt pija ko am̧ jān jinoin, im emaron̄ kōjparok n̄an 24 pija ilo juon jikin.

Kalimjōk ippān doon wōt

Kalimjōk juon wōt pija ilo juon iien. Ewor kajjitōk ko me remaron̄ kōkōm̧anm̧an bwebwenato me ejjeļo̧k menin aikuj n̄an kemejmej etan armij ak leļo̧k uwaak eo ejim̧we. Kalimjōk wōt em̧ōj an bōk jikin.

Kōjerbale n̄e ejjeļo̧k intōrnet

Pija ko n̄an jinoe im aolepen ralitōk kumi in pija ko rej koba kake ilo app in. Kōpe in pija ko em̧ōj kōpād er ilo app in rej jerbal n̄e ejjeļo̧k intōrnet. Kāālōt pija ko me rej pād wōt ilo iCloud emaron̄ aikuj intōrnet.

Ejjeļo̧k akaun, ejjeļo̧k jikin kōjparok pija ilo nōtwōk

Kōpe in pija ko an baamle rej pād wōt ilo app in ilo tūrinpeba eo am̧. Kwomaron̄ jeorļo̧k kōpe ko kōn am̧ jab kōm̧adiki pija ko jān jinoin. Men ko em̧ōj kōjparoki ilo tūrinpeba eo am̧ remaron̄ kobaik kōmeļeļe ko an app in. Riiti kakien ko kōn kōjparok kōmeļeļe ilo app, im jiban̄ an app in enaaj kwaļo̧k aolep m̧akūtkūt ko.
app.disclaimer: Golden Moments ej n̄an kakkije im bwebwenato ippān doon. Ejab n̄an kile, kōmour, kōjparok jān, ak jōn̄e jorreen in meļo̧kļo̧k ak nan̄inmej in Alzheimer’s.

gamesIndex.title: Ikkure ko ilo Intōrnet n̄an Jorreen in Meļo̧kļo̧k im Alzheimer's me Ejjeļo̧k Oņāer
gamesIndex.description: Ikkure ko ejjeļo̧k oņāer ilo intōrnet n̄an rūtto ro rej mour kōn jorreen in meļo̧kļo̧k ak Alzheimer's: kōpooļ pija, jikjo repidodo, kumiik men ko, jānnaan ko, kōkaļe, bin̄ko. Ejjeļo̧k kadiwōj etam̧, awa ak jeik.
gamesIndex.h1: Ikkure ko Repidodo n̄an Armij ro rej Mour kōn Jorreen in Meļo̧kļo̧k
gamesIndex.lede: {count} ikkure ko ejjeļo̧k oņāer n̄an ikkure ippān doon ilo browser eo am̧. Pija rekilep, naan repidodo, im ejjeļo̧k men kwoj luuji: ejjeļo̧k awa, ejjeļo̧k jeik, im ejjeļo̧k kadiwōj etam̧.
gamesIndex.listName: Ikkure ko repidodo n̄an armij ro rej mour kōn jorreen in meļo̧kļo̧k
gamesIndex.byStageTitle: Kāālōt juon ikkure ekkar n̄an jo̧o̧r eo
gamesIndex.byStageLede: Jo̧o̧r ko rej juon wōt meļeļe eidik. Lale wōt ta eo armij eo kwoj lale ej m̧ōņōņō kake im ta eo ej em̧m̧an n̄an e rainin.
gamesIndex.gamesCol: Ikkure ko me em̧m̧an n̄an er
gamesIndex.moreHtml: Eļapļo̧k lōmņak ko ijoko jab ilo kiirin: 101 m̧akūtkūt ko n̄an armij ro rej mour kōn jorreen in meļo̧kļo̧k, m̧akūtkūt im ikkure ko n̄an Alzheimer's, ikkure ko repidodo n̄an kemejmej im pajōl ko.

faq.q: Ta ikkure eo jej aikuj jino kake?
faq.a: Pija ko rejekpeļo̧k kōn emān teiļ ej juon kāālōt eo em̧m̧an n̄an jinoe. N̄e kāālōt ikōtaan pija ko ekanooj pen, kajjieon̄ Kaluuji eo ejoon kōn ruo pija. N̄an juon kumi, kajjieon̄ Bin̄ko in pija.

faq.q: Ikkure kein rej jerbal ke ilo iPad ak teļpōn?
faq.a: Aet. Aolep ikkure rej jerbal ilo browser ilo teļpōn, teblet im kom̧puutōr, im pija ko rej kilepļo̧k n̄an kanooj nooj kiirin eo. Juon teblet ioon jikin kajutak ej juon men eo ekanooj em̧m̧an n̄an ruo armij.

faq.q: Ikkure kein rem̧m̧an ke n̄an juon eo ej mour kōn Alzheimer's?
faq.a: Aet. Rōkōm̧m̧ani n̄an armij ro rej mour kōn jorreen in meļo̧kļo̧k, ekoba Alzheimer's, eo me eļap an waļo̧k. Pija ko rej pād wōt im alikkar, jejjo wōt kāālōt ko, im ejjeļo̧k awa ak jeik, kōn menin ikkure kein rej pedped ioon kile men ko me em̧ōj jeļā kajjier ijello̧kun aer kemejmej men ko rekāāl.

faq.q: Ikkure kein rej ikkure in kemejmej ke n̄an rūtto ro?
faq.a: Rej ikkure in kōpooļ im pija ko me jabdewōt rūtto emaron̄ m̧ōņōņō kaki, ak rōkōm̧m̧an er bwe ren jab mālejjon̄ kemejmej: ilo Pija ko rejekpeļo̧k pija ko rej ajeeded wōt ijello̧kun n̄e kwoj kāālōt bwe ren noje er. Kōmeļeļe eo am̧ n̄an ikkure in kemejmej n̄an rūtto ro rej mour kōn jorreen in meļo̧kļo̧k ej kōmeļeļeik ewi wāween kōm̧m̧an bwe jabdewōt ikkure en pidodo wōt.

faq.q: Ewor ke ikkure ko n̄an kumi ilo m̧ōn lale rūtto ro?
faq.a: Aet. Bin̄ko in pija ewor kaat ko kwomaron̄ pūriintiki im juon ri-kūr ilo kiirin eo, im Kadedeikļo̧k naan eo im Kaat in bwebwenato rej jerbal em̧m̧an n̄e kwonaaj riit er kōn ainikien eļap n̄an juon kumi.

appFacts.requirements: iOS 15 ak tokālik; Android 7.0 ak tokālik
appFacts.summary: Juon app ejjeļo̧k oņāān n̄an iPhone, iPad im Android kōn ikkure in kōpooļ pija repidodo ilo emān n̄an jon̄oul ruo teiļ rekilep, kōpooļ im kalimjōk pija ko an baamle me kwoj kāālōti, im ralitōk kumi in pija ko koba kake me rej jerbal n̄e ejjeļo̧k intōrnet. Ejjeļo̧k akaun, kōjjeļā in wia, awa ak jeik.
features: Kōpooļ pija repidodo kōn 4, 6, 8 ak 12 teiļ rekilep; pija ko rej alikkar wōt ijello̧kun n̄e kwoj kāālōt bwe ren noje er
Pija ko an baamle me kwoj kāālōti renaaj kōpe n̄an ilo app in n̄an kōpooļi im kalimjōki ippān doon
Kalimjōk ippān doon: juon pija ilo juon iien kōn kajjitōk ko me remaron̄ jiban̄ kōm̧anm̧an bwebwenato
Ralitōk kumi in pija ko koba kake ilo app in; rej jerbal n̄e ejjeļo̧k intōrnet
Ejjeļo̧k akaun, kōjjeļā in wia, men in wia ilo app, awa, jeik ak kaje

faq.q: Ewor ke juon app in m̧akūtkūt n̄an jorreen in meļo̧kļo̧k?
faq.a: Aet. Golden Moments (alikkar āinwōt "{storeName}") ejjeļo̧k oņāān ilo App Store im Google Play. Ej leļo̧k ikkure in kōpooļ pija repidodo kōn teiļ rekilep, ikkure ko kōn pija ko an baamle me kwoj kāālōti, im kumi in pija ko me rej jerbal n̄e ejjeļo̧k intōrnet.

faq.q: Ejjeļo̧k ke oņāān app in Golden Moments?
faq.a: Aet. Ejjeļo̧k oņāān n̄an buuki, ejjeļo̧k kōjjeļā in wia, akaun ak men in wia ilo app.

faq.q: App in ej jerbal ke n̄e ejjeļo̧k intōrnet?
faq.a: Aet. Pija ko n̄an jinoe im ralitōk kumi in pija ko rej koba kake ilo app in, im pija ko an baamle rej jerbal n̄e ejjeļo̧k intōrnet n̄e em̧ōj kōpeik er n̄an ilo app in. Kāālōt juon pija me ej pād wōt ilo iCloud emaron̄ aikuj intōrnet.

faq.q: Imaron̄ ke kōjerbal pija ko an am baamle make?
faq.a: Aet. Kāālet pija ko kōn jikin kālet pija ilo tiwaij eo am̧. App in ej dāpij kōpe ko reddikļo̧k ilo tiwaij eo n̄an makūtkūt ko an, ej jab upload e er im ejjab ukōt pija ko rejinointa. Kwomaron̄ jolo̧k kōpe ko ilo jabdewōt iien.

faq.q: Ej ke juon app in kamminene kōmļo̧kjen ak teej e kemeemej?
faq.a: Jaab. Golden Moments ej n̄an m̧ōnōnō im kōm̧m̧an iien ippān doon. Ejeļo̧k skoor ak teej ie, im ej jab kalikkar nan̄inmej, kōmour, bōbrae, ak jōn̄e dementia ak nan̄inmej in Alzheimer’s.

gameFaqYes.q: Ewōr ke juon app in ikkure in?
gameFaqYes.a: Aet. App eo ejjeļo̧k wōņāān an Golden Moments n̄an iPhone, iPad im Android ewōr juon wōt wāween kobaiki pija ilo ineemman, emaron̄ kōjerbal pija in baam̧le ko kwoj kāāleti, im ej jerbal ilo an ejjeļo̧k intōnet. Ejjeļo̧k akaun, kōjjeļā in wia, ak skoor.

gameFaqNo.q: Ewōr ke juon app in ikkure in?
gameFaqNo.a: Jaab n̄an ikkure in. App eo ejjeļo̧k wōņāān an Golden Moments n̄an iPhone, iPad im Android ewōr kobaiki pija ilo ineemman kōn taikōļ ko rekilep im pija in baam̧le ko kwoj kāāleti, im ej jerbal ilo an ejjeļo̧k intōnet. Ikkure in ej pād wōt n̄an ejjeļo̧k wōņāān ijin ilo browser eo am̧.

gamePage.newToPlayingHtml: Kāāl ke ilo am̧ ikkure ippān armij eo ewōr an nan̄inmej in meļo̧kļo̧k (dementia)? Riit wāween ikkure ippān doon, ekoba ta eo kwomaron̄ kōm̧m̧ane n̄e ejako aer itoklimo.
gamePage.appText: App eo ejjeļo̧k wōņāān an Golden Moments ewōr kobaiki pija ilo ineemman kōn taikōļ ko rekilep im pija in baam̧le ko am̧ make, im ej jerbal ilo an ejjeļo̧k Wi‑Fi. iPhone, iPad im Android.
gamePage.photoAppText: Ilo app eo ejjeļo̧k wōņāān an Golden Moments, pija ko kwoj kāāleti rej pād wōt ilo tiwaij eo am̧ n̄an bar juon iien, im ikkure ko rej jerbal meñe ejjeļo̧k Wi‑Fi. iPhone, iPad im Android.
gamePage.goodToKnowText: Ikkure in ej n̄an m̧ōnōnō im kōm̧m̧an iien ippān doon. Ej jab teej e, jōn̄e, ak kōmour jabdewōt men.
